turns.say: How do I choose the right cricket bat?
turns.message:
To choose a cricket bat, consider the player's skill level, the bat's weight and pick-up, and whether it will be used with a leather or tennis ball [1].

Beginners benefit from a forgiving bat with a large sweet spot and durable blade. Intermediate players may prefer a lighter pick-up and better-grade willow for more power. Advanced players often choose high-grade English willow with a powerful profile [1].

turns.say: What should I do if the product is defective?
turns.message: If a product seems defective, describe the fault in a support case. Whether a fault is covered depends on the warranty terms for the product and is decided by a person, not by the assistant [1]. To make a warranty claim, you need to keep your order number, report the defect within 7 days of finding it, and send clear photos of the defect [3]. A warranty claim is not a return [3]. If the product injured you or could injure someone, stop using it and say so in the support case; a case flagged as safety-related is shown to support as urgent [2].

turns.say: How does the delivery and return process work?
turns.message:
After your payment is captured, DSports automatically creates a shipment for your order [3]. You can track your order using the tracking number, which starts with TRK [3]. The shipment status will progress from CREATED to DELIVERED, at which point the 7-day return window begins [3].

To return a product, you can request a return for a product from one of your own delivered orders within 7 days of delivery [1]. You will need to provide a short reason for the return [1].
